risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (348.16), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event in 2 days, and earnings binary in 16 days create compounded downside risk for AOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend/Hull/PSAR bullish signals + extreme fear sentiment (19/100) + price near support (46.08) create contrarian setup for mean reversion into CPI event.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative MACD/CMF/OBV, weak RSI (37), no volume confirmation, earnings binary in 16 days, VIX crisis levels, inverted yield curve, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk fade into macro headwinds.
